scenes.vo: Some of your YouTube videos just don't work. And honestly? That's fine.

scenes.meaning: Few views. Few likes or comments.
scenes.vo: Bottom left: underperformers. Low views, and the few people who watch don't react much. If you still care about the topic, try one new angle. A different title, a different promise. Then give it twenty-eight days.

scenes.title: Nothing moved? Let it go.
scenes.subtitle: Your time is worth more on your hidden gems.
scenes.vo: Nothing moved? Let it go. Your time is worth way more on your hidden gems.
Backsurge sorts your whole library into these four groups, so you can see which ones are worth another shot.
